reglages.note: size 53 : le corps fait environ 62 px de haut, la taille d'un pixel de la carte v3 (héros de 1,75 unité, 35,2 px par unité). Toile de 76 px : les modèles coûtent 1 génération par direction, et une animation libre de 6 images aussi. La race passe en tête de la description (sinon PixelLab l'oublie : peau, cornes).
reglages.note_arme: Les modèles de marche font disparaître l'arme : `arme` (par perso et direction) donne où la reprendre sur la vue et où chercher la main ; arme.py la recolle à chaque image (zones à relever après la création, comme les cornes).

mort.action: is hit hard, staggers and falls backward onto the ground, ends lying still on the back; same face, skin and clothes in every frame

attaque.action: two-handed katana slash: raises the katana, then one fast diagonal slash down and forward, ends low with the front knee bent; the katana stays in both hands in every frame

speciale.action: jumps up with the katana raised overhead in both hands and slams it down into the ground in front, then stands back up; the katana stays in the hands

attaque.action: quick forward slash with the short blade held in the right hand, then back to guard

speciale.action: spins around once low to the ground with the blade arm extended, a whirling slash, then back to a crouching guard; the blade stays in the right hand

attaque.action: short sword slash from behind the round shield, the shield stays on the left arm, then back to guard

speciale.action: throws the round shield forward like a spinning disc with the left arm, the sword stays in the right hand

attaque.action: raises the bow, draws the string back to the cheek and releases an arrow forward, then lowers the bow; the bow stays in the left hand

speciale.action: kneels on one knee, draws the bow string all the way back and releases a powerful shot, then stands up; the bow stays in the left hand

attaque.action: flicks a paper talisman forward from the right hand

speciale.action: raises both hands then thrusts them forward, casting a spell

races.hanyo: half-oni man with ash grey-blue skin and two short pointed ivory-white horns sticking up out of the hair above the forehead
races.einherjar: undead Norse viking warrior with pale grey scarred skin, long braided hair and a braided beard
races.oushebti: living Egyptian statuette whose whole body is blue-green glazed faience with thin cracks, painted kohl-lined eyes
races.demi-dieu: Greek demigod with a thin golden ring floating above the head like a halo

persos.description: ronin warrior: black hair in a topknot, dark red kimono, dark grey hakama, straw sandals, a plain katana of normal length held in the right hand
shinobi assassin: short black hair, dark charcoal fitted clothes, a dark scarf, cloth wraps on forearms and shins, split-toe tabi, one short straight tanto blade in the right hand
sohei temple guardian: white head cowl, dark blue monk robe with plain armor plates, sandals, a round wooden shield with an iron rim on the left arm, a short straight sword in the right hand
archer: red hachimaki headband, indigo kimono with the sleeves tied back by a red cord, slate grey hakama, a quiver on the back, a simple Japanese bow in the left hand
onmyoji sorcerer: tall black eboshi hat, loose white and pale grey robes with wide sleeves, paper talismans with red ink held between the fingers of the right hand
viking berserker: mail shirt with iron shoulder plates, wolf-fur mantle, studded leather belt, fur-trimmed boots, a plain long sword of normal length held in the right hand
raider skirmisher: fitted dark leather jerkin, hooded wolf-grey cloak, cloth face scarf, leather bracers, one short single-edged seax knife in the right hand
shield guardian: long pale linen tunic with gold bands, mail coif, fur-trimmed cape, a round wooden shield with an iron rim on the left arm, a straight sword in the right hand
hunter: fur-lined hooded jerkin, leather trousers, fur boots, a wolf pelt over the shoulders, a quiver on the back, a simple wooden longbow in the left hand
fire seer: long dark wool robe with ember-red rune embroidery, fur-trimmed hooded cloak, small rune stones on cords at the belt, carved bone rune talismans held in the right hand
warrior: striped nemes headdress, gilded scale cuirass, striped shendyt kilt, broad usekh collar, bronze bracers, a long straight bronze sword held in the right hand
assassin: dark linen wraps, a striped head cloth, a narrow belt, one curved bronze dagger in the right hand
temple guardian: white linen robe with gold trim, striped nemes headdress, a round bronze shield on the left arm, a straight bronze sword in the right hand
hunter: short linen kilt, leather chest strap, a quiver on the back, a simple recurved bow in the left hand
priest sorcerer: long white linen priest robe, gold usekh collar, a shaved painted head, papyrus talismans with red hieroglyphs held in the right hand

Spartan demigod warrior in black and gold: black Corinthian helmet with a tall black horsehair crest, black muscle cuirass with gold trim, leather strip skirt, a curved Greek kopis sword in the right hand
demigoddess assassin: very long straight silver-white hair, a long black dress slit up one side, sheer black sleeves, one curved silver sickle blade (harpe) in the right hand
